France: ICC warrant no barrier to Netanyahu overflight

France has stated that an International Criminal Court (ICC) arrest warrant did not prevent Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu from flying over French airspace. Meanwhile, in Canada, officials are reviewing whether Netanyahu's flight path constitutes a violation of Canadian airspace given the existing arrest warrant.
